blend_note: NNLS gave linear weight=0.0; gbdt alone (0.852974) is the promoted submission. Blend OOF was 0.8519 at label level — marginally below gbdt alone, likely due to hard-label blending; ensemble-meta correctly chose gbdt. Linear is dead weight (weight=0, OOF=0.8328, 2.4pp below gbdt).

ensemble_assessment.diversity_note: Linear (C=0.05, 31 configs, 5-seed averaged) is 2.4pp below gbdt. Blend is still below gbdt alone — hard-label ensemble gains are limited vs probability ensemble. No third family (e.g. RandomForest) available to add uncorrelated diversity.
ensemble_assessment.untried_family: RandomForestClassifier or ExtraTreesClassifier — uncorrelated with LightGBM on small datasets

stability_note: 5-fold std=0.0122, relative_stability=1.43% — good stability. No fold dominates. Overfit risk is low.

round2_vs_round1.verdict: Positive gain (+0.45pp, +0.73% of baseline) from round-1 feature additions: is_child, is_large_family, is_alone, fare_per_person, tgt_mean_title, tgt_mean_Sex_Pclass, and predict_proba fix all confirmed in agent_gbdt.json feature list (28 features vs ~22 inferred round 1).

prediction_sanity.note: Slight under-prediction of survivals (3.7pp gap). Not alarming for Titanic; test set may genuinely have fewer survivors.

residual_analysis_note: state.json residual_analysis is empty — binary classification; no quantile regression residuals available. Confusion matrix from floor evaluation (test): FN=20 (missed survivors) is the primary error mode, FP=14. The gbdt specialist likely reduces both vs the floor logistic regression.

suggestions.suggestion: Drop linear family in any future round (NNLS weight=0, OOF 2.4pp below gbdt). Replace with RandomForestClassifier (200 trees, max_features=sqrt) to add uncorrelated diversity against LightGBM.
suggestions.implementation_hint: Add family='rf' specialist with sklearn RandomForestClassifier; drop linear specialist dispatch. NNLS blend will assign positive weight only if RF adds genuine uncorrelated signal.

suggestions.suggestion: LightGBM learning_rate and depth ranges not reported in agent_gbdt.json. Lower lr (0.01-0.03) with more trees (500-800) and min_child_samples tuning may squeeze 0.5-1pp on 891 rows.
suggestions.implementation_hint: In gbdt specialist: extend lr grid to [0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.05]; num_leaves in [15, 31, 63]; min_child_samples in [5, 10, 20]. Use early stopping with OOF.
